generic_domain.justification: The term 'score-based modeling' is more comprehensive and generic compared to 'score-based models'. 'Score-based modeling' refers to the methodology or framework used to create models where scores are assigned, which can include a variety of approaches such as generative models, ranking systems, among others. On the other hand, 'score-based models' specifically refers to particular instances of models that utilize scoring mechanisms, but it may not cover all aspects and variations encompassed within the broader modeling framework.
